title: TRACTORS
description: Massey Ferguson tractors deliver straightforward and dependable performance, comfort and uncompromising quality. Efficient, reliable engines using the latest technology work with sophisticated yet user-friendly and efficent transmissions to meet the farmer's needs and get the best from a wide range of implements, while minimising running costs and maximising uptime.

title: COMBINES
description: Pioneers of combine harvester technology from the PowerFlow header to the latest precision farming equipment, the Massey Ferguson range includes models from 185-660hp. Conventional straw walker and rotor technology systems are available to match all crops and conditions.

title: BALERS
description: Massey Ferguson round and big square balers are engineered to last and designed to pack the maximum material in each package for easier handling, storage and use. The latest technology allows operators to easily monitor and record harvest data.

title: ROTARY
description: With three models from 483hp to 660hp, the MF IDEAL harnesses industry leading technology to deliver more grain at the best quality, for you. Fully connected and with unique new features, these combines excel on all fronts, offering superb grain and straw quality, massive output, super-fast operation, outstanding driver comfort, total efficiency and control.

title: WALKERS
description: Massey Ferguson straw-walker combines provide straightforward and dependable harvesting performance. There is a choice of models with five or six straw-walkers, with engine powers from to 185hp to 360hp and capable of harvesting with headers from 4.2m to 7.7m. The patented ParaLevel option helps maintain peak performance with auto-levelling on slopes up to 20%.

title: HEADERS
description: Heads first feed – start well, finish well - your header is critical to how well your combine performs. With a lifetime of experience, Massey Ferguson offers you a choice of its premium MF PowerFlow table or high capacity MF FreeFlow table. Both provide features to boost productivity, including Automatic Reel speed and advanced table height control.

title: MF IDEAL
description: With three models from 483hp to 660hp, the MF IDEAL harnesses industry leading technology to deliver more grain at the best quality, for you. Fully connected and with unique new features, these combines excel on all fronts, offering superb grain and straw quality, massive output, super-fast operation, outstanding driver comfort, total efficiency and control.

title: MF COMBINE HARVESTERS
description: Massey Ferguson straw-walker combines provide straightforward and dependable harvesting performance. There is a choice of models with five or six straw-walkers, with engine powers from to 176hp to 360hp and capable of harvesting with headers from 4.2m to 7.7m. The patented ParaLevel option helps maintain peak performance with auto-levelling on slopes up to 20%.

title: MF COMBINE HEADERS
description:
Heads first feed – start well, finish well - your header is critical to how well your combine performs. With a lifetime of experience, Massey Ferguson offers you a choice of its premium MF PowerFlow table or high capacity MF FreeFlow table.

Both provide features to boost productivity, including Automatic Reel speed and advanced table height control.

title: HAY & FORAGE
description: With the addition of this impressive range of MF Hay and Forage equipment to its current Tractor, Harvesting and Materials Handling portfolio, Massey Ferguson is proud to offer a full-line of equipment, including high quality, robust and energy-efficient Mowers, Conditioners, Tedders and Rakes

title: MATERIAL HANDLING
description: For fast and efficient handling, discover the latest generation MF TH Series telehandlers and MF FL Series loaders. The MF TH Series telehandlers includes a total of 6 models. The MF FL Series Loaders allows you to complement your Massey Ferguson tractor with a combination of rugged ability, hard work and reliability.

title: SMALL SQUARE
description: The small rectangular baler employs a centre-line design in which the crops flows through the machine in a straight line - working like a mini large square baler, improving efficiency because the crop is not turned before entering the chamber.

title: TRAILED/MOUNTED MOWERS
description: Massey Ferguson’s extensive hay and forage range includes a vast selection of innovative and efficient mowers and mower conditioners that deliver high quality results in all crops and conditions.

title: FRONT LOADERS
description:
A complete range of Massey Ferguson loaders are available to increase versatility.
Offering no less than 29 models, with lift capacities from 1,210 kg to 3,270 kg, at heights from 3.10m to 4.96 m, depending on tractor size.

title: TELESCOPIC HANDLERS
description: For fast and efficient loading, the MF TH Series telehandlers includes models from the compact MF TH.6030, ideal for working in restricted spaces, up to the MF TH.8043 that can lift the heaviest loads. A total of six models can take loads from 3,000kg to 4,300kg to maximum heights of 5.9m to 7.5m. All are powered by 100hp or 130hp engines and have an effortless hydrostatic transmission. An optional high-performance Dyna-CT transmission is available for models MF TH.6534, MF TH.7038 and MF TH.8043.

title: MF TH
description: For fast and efficient loading, the MF TH Series telehandlers includes models from the compact MF TH.6030, ideal for working in restricted spaces, up to the MF TH.8043 that can lift the heaviest loads. A total of six models can take loads from 3,000kg to 4,300kg to maximum heights of 5.9m to 7.5m. All are powered by 100hp or 130hp engines and have an effortless hydrostatic transmission. An optional high-performance Dyna-CT transmission is available for models MF TH.6534, MF TH.7038 and MF TH.8043.

title: LARGE SQUARE
description: These square balers make dense, well-formed bales, and are renowned for their reliability, longevity and low cost of ownership.

title: TEDDERS
description: Massey Ferguson offers a choice of 15 MF TD Tedders for fast efficient forage tedding to improve feed quality. These are available with working widths from 4.5m to 12.7m, with four to ten rotors and, depending on the model, with five, six or seven tine bars. All are simple and easy to set-up and adjust. Synchronised lifting of outer rotors, a central hydraulic lift system with pressure cylinders ease operation help maintain optimum performance – even on slopes.

title: MF DISC MOWERS
description: Massey Ferguson offers a vast choice of front- and rear-mounted, trailed and butterfly folding mowers with a choice of tine or roller conditioners. Suitable for contractor or farmer users, these come with a range of mounting and folding systems in widths from 1.66m to 3.62m and from 8.3m and 9.3m for the butterfly versions.
